Sam H (CS): Heads-up 10-day renewal with Meridian Labs. They want a plain SLO summary for the last 90 days and to know if any credits apply. Can someone own numbers + wording?
Ethan V (Ops): I'll pull the numbers. Suggest a 24h freeze before we send.
Nora L (Customer): Short and simple please. Just: uptime number, whether credit applies, one-sentence cause if needed.
Priya S (Eng): Note: brief p95 spike on 2026-04-02 during a model refresh; fixed within 30m by reverting the rollout.
Ethan V (Ops): Pre-freeze figures: uptime=99.947% (90d), p50=90ms, p95=320ms. That falls into >=99.95%? Actually just under: 99.947% < 99.95%, so maps to [99.9%,99.95%) => 0.25% credit. I'll confirm counts for transparency.
Sam H (CS): Draft customer sentence: "Over the past 90 days we observed 99.947% uptime. This places Meridian Labs within the contract tier that qualifies for a one-time credit equal to 0.25% of one month's committed usage. We observed a short latency increase on 2026-04-02 due to a model refresh rollout; the rollout was reverted and the fix completed within 30 minutes." Keep it two sentences.
Nora L (Customer): Perfect. Could you include a tiny transparency snippet like below?
```
Period: 90 days
Observed uptime: 99.947% (numerator: 8751420 / denominator: 8752100 checks)
Contract tiers: >=99.95% = no credit; [99.9%,99.95%) = 0.25% credit
Result: eligible for 0.25% one-month credit
```
Ethan V (Ops): Will attach exact counts after data freeze (deadline 2026-04-11 09:00 PT).
Sam H (CS): Great. I'll assemble slide + email and tag you both for a quick sign-off. Thanks :thumbsup:
